summary: United Microelectronics Corp filed a Form 6-K to disclose that its cumulative share repurchases exceeded NT$300 million in value as of May 12, 2026. The company repurchased 1,919,000 common shares at an average price of NT$101.55 per share, bringing total treasury shares to 10,251,000, representing 0.08% of total issued shares. This is a routine buyback disclosure by a foreign issuer under Rule 13a-16, not a formal tender offer or capital return program. The filing is a standard update with no board recommendation, advisor, or structural complexity. No special-situation triggering event is present.
